summary: Registering an OAuth app in Developer Hub is straightforward: create a sandbox account, pick public or private, enter app details and scopes, then install and test. A public Marketplace listing additionally requires a website, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, email confirmation, and review by the Marketplace team before you can publish. No review timeline is published, and each end user must individually install the app.

steps.title: Sign up for a developer sandbox account
steps.detail: Create a Pipedrive developer sandbox account so you can access Developer Hub.

steps.title: Create the app in Developer Hub
steps.detail: Log in to Developer Hub on your developer sandbox account, click “Create an app,” choose public or private, and fill in Basic Info: App name and OAuth Callback URL. A non-functioning callback URL is acceptable temporarily, but only one callback URL is allowed per app.

steps.title: Configure access scopes
steps.detail: In the “OAuth & access scopes” tab, select the access scopes your app needs based on the endpoints it will use.

steps.title: Obtain client_id and client_secret
steps.detail: Save the form; you are automatically taken to “OAuth & access scopes” where your client_id and client_secret are generated. Copy them for OAuth authorization.

steps.title: Implement OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow
steps.detail: Send the user to the authorize endpoint with client_id, redirect_uri, and optional state. After the user clicks “Allow and install,” exchange the authorization_code at POST /oauth/token using Basic auth of client_id:client_secret. The redirect_uri must exactly match Developer Hub. The authorization_code becomes invalid more than 5 minutes after issue.
steps.agent_prompt: Write the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow code: build the authorize URL, handle the callback, exchange the code for access_token and refresh_token at /oauth/token, and store tokens per company. Emphasize exact redirect_uri matching.

steps.title: Add public listing legal and website URLs
steps.detail: For a public app, provide Website URL, Terms of Service URL, and Privacy Policy URL in Developer Hub.

steps.title: Install and test the app
steps.detail: Use “Install & test” in Developer Hub to allow and install your app via the OAuth confirmation dialog before review.

steps.title: Confirm email address
steps.detail: Confirm the email address sent to the main contact email; this is required for all public apps.

steps.title: Send app to review
steps.detail: Agree to the Pipedrive Developer Partner Agreement and click the green “Send to review” button. Provide any test account information the Marketplace team needs.

steps.title: Wait for Marketplace review and publish
steps.detail: The app status changes to “In review.” When approved and working as expected, use the “Publish” button to make it publicly available.

blockers.symptom: App cannot be sent for approval or published
blockers.fix: Confirm your email address, agree to the Developer Partner Agreement, click “Send to review,” provide test account info, and wait for Marketplace review before clicking Publish.

blockers.symptom: OAuth redirect error or Invalid redirect URL
blockers.fix: Ensure the redirect_uri in the authorization request exactly matches the callback URL defined in Developer Hub; only one callback URL is allowed per app.

blockers.symptom: Authorization code is invalid or expired
blockers.fix: Exchange the authorization_code promptly; it becomes invalid more than 5 minutes after issue and cannot be reused.

blockers.symptom: Private app not visible in Marketplace
blockers.fix: Private apps are not published; submit a public app through the approval process and click Publish after approval.

composio.notes: Check the toolkit page for managed auth. To bring your own app, register the redirect URI shown when you create a custom auth config.
